log.msg: Qwen (qwen2.5-coder:7b) is designing the kitchen - under a minute
Applying the MagickHome rule book: module sizes for this kitchen size and shape
Applying design rules: window, door, corner and chimney clearances
Building the 3D scene: cabinets, appliances, countertops, panels

raw.room_reading: The kitchen is a square room with four equal walls, each measuring 4100 mm. There is a door at the Wall 4 corner and a window in the centre of Wall 2. The floor area is 172 sqft. The wall height is 2500 mm.
raw.design_plan: The kitchen will have a large L-shape layout with the hob on Wall 1 and the sink on Wall 2. The base cabinets will be primarily shutters for a clean look. A loft will be added above the wall units to
raw.layout_why: This layout maximizes space and functionality while ensuring a good workflow between cooking and cleaning.
raw.sink_why: The sink will be placed on Wall 2 to take advantage of the window and provide a large work surface.
raw.hob_why: The hob will be placed on Wall 1 to be centrally located and within easy reach for cooking.
raw.lpg_why: The LPG cylinder unit will be included as per rule R11.
raw.tall_why: Tall storage units will be added above the wall units for additional storage.
raw.purifier_why: Water purifier will be added above the sink wall for easy access.
raw.display_why: Glass display unit will be added on the opposite side of the hob for visual appeal and display purposes.
raw.open_why: An open shelf unit will be added on the opposite side of the sink for additional storage and organization.
raw.storage_why: Additional storage units will be added on the opposite side of the hob for better organization.
raw.features_why: The base storage will be primarily shutters for a clean look.
raw.wall_cabinets_why: The wall cabinets will be primarily shutters for a clean look.
raw.wall_style_why: The wall cabinets will be hinged shutters for a clean and modern look.
raw.finish_why: The base and wall cabinets will be finished in a matte PU finish for durability and a clean look.
raw.loft_why: Lofts will be added above the wall units to provide additional storage and visual appeal.
